svg.text: AWS CDK (Python) · What is it and what is its lifecycle?
Infrastructure as code in a real language
Python, TypeScript, Java…: define VPC, ECS and
ALB with classes and objects, not hand-written YAML.
An app can have several stacks.
In the lab: base, frontend, nodejs, crystal.
CDK does not deploy by itself
The code is the source of truth.
• Changing things via console/CLI and the next deploy reverting them (drift)
• Missing tags/permissions and the stack goes into ROLLBACK
• Versions: aws-cdk-lib (Python) and the cdk CLI (npm) must be compatible
